chunks: And Muḥammad ibn Muslim narrated from one of the two Imams, peace be upon them:
Regarding a muhrim whose hands crack, he said: "He may anoint them with oil, fat, or melted fat."

key_terms.إِهَالَةٍ: melted fat or grease used as an ointment
key_terms.الْمُحْرِمِ: a person in the state of iḥram during hajj or 'umrah
key_terms.تَشَقَّقُ: become cracked or split due to dryness
key_terms.يَدْهُنُهُمَا: he applies ointment or anoints them

ai.seo_question: Can a muhrim apply oil or fat to cracked hands while in iḥram?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the muhrim in iḥram whose hands become cracked. It permits applying oil, fat, or melted fat as a treatment, showing allowance for necessary care during iḥram.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2658 - Muhammad ibn Muslim narrated from one of the Imams (as) regarding a Muhrim whose hands have cracked.
Imam (as) said: "He may anoint them with oil, fat, or melted fat (ihalah)."
